gui.help.title: Help
gui.help.why.title: Why the sound got bad
gui.help.why.body: When a game or app turns on the microphone of Bluetooth headphones, Windows switches them to call mode. In call mode the sound is mono and muffled. The app shows who turned the microphone on and brings stereo back.
gui.help.fix.title: Bring back stereo
gui.help.fix.body: Restarts the headphone sound once. Windows settings do not change and the headphone microphone keeps working, so there is nothing to undo.
gui.help.hard.title: Always stereo
gui.help.hard.body: Blocks call mode: the sound is always stereo, but the headphone microphone does not work. Before turning it on, the app remembers how things were, and turning it off puts everything back exactly.
gui.help.mic.title: If the sound turns mono again
gui.help.mic.body: An app turned the headphone microphone on again. The panel shows which one: close it or choose another microphone in it. If the headphones are the default microphone, choose another one in Windows Sound settings.
gui.help.undo.title: How to put everything back
gui.help.undo.body:
The app changes only one thing in Windows: “Always stereo”. If the caption under the switch says “Off: Windows is set up exactly as without the app”, there is nothing to undo.

To remove the app completely:
1. Turn “Always stereo” off if it is on.
2. In Settings, turn off “Start with Windows”.
3. Click “Quit” and uninstall the app in Settings → Apps (or delete the file if you downloaded it yourself).

Step 1 first, then uninstall: once removed, the app can no longer bring the headphone microphone back.
gui.help.safety.title: Safety
gui.help.safety.body: Showing the status needs no special rights. For “Bring back stereo” and “Always stereo”, Windows asks for permission every time.
gui.help.details.title: For the curious
gui.help.details.body: Call mode is the Bluetooth HFP profile, stereo is A2DP. Bluetooth Classic cannot do both at once. The app manages the Windows services BTAGService and BthHFSrv. After uninstalling, only its settings in %AppData%\BluetoothHandsFreeToggle and its log in %LocalAppData%\BluetoothHandsFreeToggle remain. They do not affect the sound, and you can delete these folders.
